name: toll
description: Open-source, x402-style pay-per-request gateway that lets AI agents pay for APIs and content with PayPal, guarded by plain-English spending rules.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n gateway,sites,agent,dashboard -c cyan,magenta,yellow,green "npm run start -w @toll/gateway" "npm run start -w @toll/demo-sites" "npm run serve -w @toll/agent" "npm run dev -w @toll/dashboard"
